name.full: CSM Advisor for Microsoft Copilot Cowork

description.short: One combined summary across Word, PDF, text, PowerPoint, and Excel files.
description.full: CSM Advisor reads a set of files in Word (.docx), PDF (.pdf), plain text (.txt), PowerPoint (.pptx) and Excel (.xlsx/.xls) formats, optionally adds your Microsoft Teams meeting recaps, extracts their content, and produces a single consolidated summary covering all analyzed files together - including cross-file themes and a suggested learning path - instead of one summary per file.
